user_story:
As a user, I want to test the links on the Links page to ensure they issue the correct API calls and handle the responses properly, so that I can verify the application's reliability. Acceptance Criteria: 
1. When I click on the link with text 'Created', it should not navigate away from the page and the URL should remain the same. 
2. When I click on the link with text 'No Content', it should also not navigate away and the URL should remain the same.
